Also switched snapshot.py's read path from the blocked public Blogger feed (unreachable from this sandbox's network policy) to the Blogger API v3, which this repo's own blogger_api.py already uses for every publish -- same data, different already-authenticated channel. One side effect: the API doesn't expose sub-second timestamp precision, so the 3 posts below whose original published/updated times happened to carry non-zero milliseconds show as re-dated even though nothing about them actually moved -- a one-time precision-rounding artifact from this migration, not a real date change.
